body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: ea18ff81a3faa64f4f215781eb8adf36163bc629 -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge** (one gate, not a code defect: the offset-writing path is still unverified on a control).

Thanks for the careful work and the honest "not verified" list.

**What looks good**
- Fails safe by design: G38.2 makes the control error on no contact; the back-off is incremental (G91..G90); an out-of-tolerance result shows (MSG) and stops at M2 before any offset is written.
- The offset is `G10 L20 P<n>` from #5420.. minus the deviation, so no unit mixing, and the slot comes from the op's explicit `set_wcs` (no second G54-G59 derivation in the post; the active WCS is the section's own).
- Touch probe starts no spindle, belt note or coolant (`assets/posts/tormach.cps` startPreamble).
- Decision file `docs/decisions/362-tormach-probe.md` present with sources and rejected options; `Changelog:` and `Fixes #362` present; no CHANGELOG.md edit; no build.rs/.github/dependency changes; no new `.rs` code beyond tests. CPS is exempt from the 400-line law.
- The `#n=[expr]` bracket fix after the Hub error is pinned by `assignments_are_bracketed` on every golden.

**Local results (PR merged with current main, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `probe_tormach` | 7 passed |
| `probe_op` | 12 passed |
| `tormach_post`, `tormach_machines`, `conformance` | 6 / 5 / 10 passed |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app --tests -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. Items 1-4 of your own "not verified on a control" comment are posted G-code that has not run on a real Tormach. The one that can fail silently is `G10 L20 P<n>` (assembly of `X[#5420-#190]`): if it is wrong in inch or mm it writes a wrong work offset with no error. Please either confirm it on a 770MX (offset table after one probe run, inch and mm) and the G91 back-off after a trip, or have the maintainer explicitly accept shipping it unverified. Until then it should not be flagged merge-ready.
2. The PR body still says "draft until done" and lists the Hub checks as owed; update it to the current state (Hub load verified, control checks owed) so the record matches.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Verified only by loading in PathPilot Hub; the travel warnings you described come from the sim's G54 placement, agreed they are not the post.
- Preview likely reports probe end points, so tolerance tests may read as failed there (already in the decision file).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
